jobs.description:
Customised customer solutions require a supplier base that can support complexity, speed and technical value creation. As Sourcing Manager – Design-to-Order (DTO), you will strengthen NOVENCO’s competitive position by building supplier partnerships that support engineered solutions, modular thinking, cost optimisation and supply chain resilience.

Your Impact

• 
Identify, evaluate and develop suppliers for customised components, balancing quality, cost, delivery performance, sustainability and supply chain risk.

• 
Bring the right suppliers into early design phases to support Design for Manufacturing principles and optimise total cost of ownership.

• 
Negotiate framework agreements, contracts and pricing structures that support volatile demand, complex components and project-specific requirements.

• 
Build long-term supplier partnerships capable of handling special materials, technical complexity, variable order volumes and long lead times.

• 
Monitor supplier performance through KPIs, with particular focus on delivery reliability, quality, cost efficiency and compliance with standards.

• 
Identify commonalities across customised products to increase component reuse, reduce complexity and support a more scalable supply base.

What Drives Success

• 
Solid experience with Design-to-Order sourcing, international procurement and global supply chain management.

• 
Strong understanding of modular architecture, supplier segmentation, risk management, compliance and relevant quality and sustainability standards.

• 
Commercial strength combined with technical understanding from a project-oriented or engineered-to-order environment.

• 
Ability to challenge design concepts early to prevent unnecessary cost, complexity and material risk.

• 
Strong negotiation skills and professional English communication, both written and spoken.

What We Offer

• 
A central role in Global Sourcing with direct impact on NOVENCO’s supplier strategy and competitiveness.

• 
The opportunity to shape strategic supplier partnerships for complex, customised and technically demanding solutions.

• 
Close collaboration with R&D, Project, Quality, Product Development and Supply Chain stakeholders.

• 
Exposure to international suppliers, markets and material networks, including expected travel of 30–40 days per year.

• 
Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

• 
25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• 
Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• 
Professional development and training through NOVENCollege, with clear progression paths.

Context

The role is part of Global Sourcing and reports to the Head of Global Sourcing. You will work at the intersection of customised customer solutions, DTO, R&D, Projects and Supply Chain, with supplier visits in Denmark and internationally.

How to apply

Please submit your CV via our careers page. Applications are reviewed on receipt and interviews are scheduled on a rolling basis.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

About NOVENCO® Building & Industry A/S

Engineering a Greener and Safer World

At NOVENCO, we create ventilation solutions that deliver high energy efficiency with minimal environmental impact. Our mission is clear: provide sustainable systems with low life-cycle costs that meet – and consistently exceed – customer expectations.

Reliability for Life Safety

Our life-safety ventilation solutions are engineered for absolute reliability. Designed to meet the highest international standards, they support critical applications across numerous industries, where dependable performance is essential to safeguarding people, property and operations.

Innovation Since 1947

With more than seven decades of engineering expertise, we continue to refine our products and production processes. Our automated, high-tech manufacturing, supported by advanced robotics, ensures minimal waste and maximum recyclability. This results in a product portfolio recognised for long service life, exceptional durability and proven sustainability.

Are you a university student with strong programming skills in R and LaTeX? Do you want to gain hands-on experience supporting drug development in a leading pharmaceutical company?

Ascendis Pharma is looking for a Student Assistant to join our Pharmacometrics department in Hellerup.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Student Assistant to join our team. As a member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in supporting the maintenance and development of our pharmacometrics modelling platform, contributing to analyses used in drug development.

You will be joining the Pharmacometrics Department and be based in Hellerup. You will join a collaborative team of experienced pharmacometricians, a pharmacometrics programmer, and colleagues with recent experience as student helpers. You will gain hands-on experience working on real-world drug development challenges.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining and developing R and LaTeX templates

• Supporting QC of regulatory documents and calculations

Qualifications and skills

You are currently enrolled and pursuing an academic degree. Ideally studying statistics, mathematics, data science, bioinformatics, biomedicine, pharmacy or similar.

Furthermore, you have:

• Completed at least 2 years of university studies and has at least 2 years remaining, studying

• Understand object-oriented programming and clinical time-series data

• Has strong programming skills in R (e.g., dplyr, tidyverse) and preferably experience with LaTeX (e.g., knitr, hyperref or cleveref)

• Is detail-oriented with a scientific mindset, and enjoys writing efficient and structured code (e.g., functions, packages, ggplot)

It is an advantage if you:

• Have experience with Git

• Have an interest in pharmacometrics and drug development

• Have experience with non-linear fixed effects modeling (NONMEM) and differential equations

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be service-minded and would like to work in a diverse team with many different ongoing tasks

Hours: approx.4-8 hours per week. We want you to be able to balance your studies and work responsibilities and therefore offer flexibility during exam periods.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup (presence in the office is expected)

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.

If you would like to learn more, please contact Kristin C. Petri, Sr. Director, Head of Pharmacometrics (mailto: ).

You can learn more about Ascendis by visiting our website

A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation.  Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed.  If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

Want to work at the intersection of customer experience, digital solutions and commercial innovation?

This is your chance to be part of shaping how we create value for users and healthcare professionals — in a global MedTech company.

We are looking for two student assistants to join our Customer Experience organization at HQ in Humlebæk. One of our recent student assistants has just transitioned into a full-time role after two years in the team — and we are now looking for new talent to continue building the function.

In Customer Experience, we work to deliver superior customer experiences and be the trusted partner for our users/patients and healthcare professionals (e.g. nurses).

Join Customer Experience and collaborate across four global teams

You will be part of a newly established Customer Experience organization, working across four teams: User Experience, HCP Experience, Service Operational Excellence, and Digital Marketing & Demand Generation.

Together, we define, develop and implement the future customer experience — from understanding user needs and shaping digital journeys to creating content and enabling scalable solutions across markets. In this role, you will get hands-on experience working across all four teams and learn how different parts of a global commercial organization come together.

Build your commercial understanding and competencies

As a Student Assistant, you will work approx. 15–20 hours per week and support across the department — gaining exposure to a broad range of topics by collaborating across multiple teams, which is a unique opportunity in a student role. You will refer to a manager who will help you prioritize and develop in the role.

Tasks will vary, but are likely to include:

•    Supporting Customer Experience projects across user experience, HCP experience, service operations and digital marketing

•    Contributing to user research, customer insights and digital initiatives

•    Coordinating stakeholder input and helping drive activities across teams and markets

•    Assisting with PowerPoint preparation, project coordination and stakeholder input

•    Supporting the team with administrative and ad hoc tasks

A proactive student who enjoys creating impact and turning ideas into action

You are curious and motivated by creating impact. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating with different stakeholders and helping move initiatives forward. You are not afraid to challenge existing thinking, explore new ideas and turn opportunities into action.

We imagine that you:

•    Are currently studying a bachelor’s or master’s degree within business, marketing, digital, innovation or similar

•    Enjoy working across different teams, topics and problem types

•    Are proactive, pragmatic and motivated by getting things done

•    Have strong PowerPoint skills

•    Are fluent in English, written and spoken

•    Bring a commercial mindset and enjoy connecting the dots across disciplines

•    Enjoy working with people and building relationships across functions and markets

•    Experience with content platforms, Excel or design tools is a plus, but not a requirement

What we offer

You will become part of a global, purpose-driven organization with strong ambitions for Customer Experience. You will gain hands-on experience working across projects, teams and disciplines — and contribute to work that makes a real difference for users and healthcare professionals.

You will also have the opportunity to be part of Coloplast Young Professionals, a community where students and early-career colleagues connect, network and participate in both professional and social events across the organization.

Working in Humlebæk might feel far from your studies (e.g. in Copenhagen), but Coloplast offers a shuttle bus between the train station and the office. As you get into the role and become more confident in your tasks, you will also have flexibility to work from home when needed — especially during busy periods like exams.

Ready to apply?

If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply today. For more information about the role, feel free to reach out to Signe Bunke at dksbun@coloplast.com.

We will review applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to submit yours. This position will remain open until the right candidate has been found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Job Description

Do you want to take senior hands-on technical ownership of how mission-critical data centers are designed, expanded, and handed over for operation?

GlobalConnect is expanding data center capacity across the Nordics and Northern Europe. To support this growth, we are strengthening our Large Projects organization with a Data Center Designer based in Taastrup.

This is a senior specialist role at our highest specialist level. You will act as a technical authority across large data center projects, influence design direction, challenge key technical decisions, and help shape more consistent ways of working across countries.

The role is a hands-on role. You will work directly with layouts, power and cooling concepts, system architecture, technical documentation, supplier designs, commissioning readiness, and operational handover. This is not a technician or installation role, but you should enjoy getting close to the technical solution and being present in the data center environment.

What you need to succeed

• Hands on experience with data center infrastructure or other mission-critical environments, such as energy, pharma, industrial facilities, or similar

• Strong understanding of cooling systems and power infrastructure in mission-critical environments

• Proven hands-on experience with alarm and monitoring systems, including system architecture and integration with critical infrastructure such as power, cooling, and security

• Ability to interpret, review, and challenge engineering drawings, technical documentation, specifications, supplier designs, and system architecture choices

• Fluent English. Danish or another Nordic language is an advantage

About the role and the team

You will join a small, senior, and specialized team working across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, and Germany. The team works closely across borders and is building a more consistent pan-Nordic approach to data center design, expansion, and operational readiness.

In Denmark, this role closes an important capability gap. You will bring deep technical design expertise into a setup that already has strong project management capability. You will work closely with Project Managers, Sales, Procurement, external consultants, vendors, customers, and Operations.

A key part of the role is to act as a trusted technical advisor. You will help translate customer needs into technically sound solutions, challenge assumptions when needed, and ensure that design choices support long-term reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.

What you’ll be working on

• Act as technical authority within large data center projects, from early concept through commissioning, acceptance, and handover

• Own and challenge system-level design decisions across power, cooling, controls, alarm and monitoring systems, security, and building interfaces

• Review layouts, airflow concepts, cooling capacity assumptions, power distribution principles, single-line diagrams, and supplier designs

• Develop and review technical requirements, specifications, scopes of supply, risk assessments, and design documentation

• Support FATs, site inspections, commissioning activities, acceptance testing, and operational handover

• Strengthen standardisation, repeatable technical solutions, and design quality across projects and countries

Who we are looking for

You are a senior mechanical technical specialist who enjoys working with complex systems, high expectations, and decisions that have long-term operational impact.

You are confident in your technical judgement and comfortable challenging designs, suppliers, consultants, customers, and internal stakeholders when the solution needs to be improved. You can explain complex technical choices clearly and help others understand the trade-offs between reliability, cost, schedule, scalability, and operational readiness.

You enjoy working close to the physical technical solution. You are comfortable reviewing drawings, questioning assumptions, calculating capacity, discussing design alternatives, and explaining why a solution will work in practice.

To succeed in this role, you should also be motivated by building trust across teams. The role requires close collaboration with Sales, Projects, Operations, vendors, and customers, especially where expectations, technical reality, and operational needs must be aligned.

Does this sound like you? If so, we would love to hear from you.

Our recruitment process

• Talent Acquisition Screen

• Hiring Manager interview

• Personality and ability tests feedback and discussion with Talent Acquisition

• Case interview with Hiring Manager and peer/stakeholder

• Final alignment meeting

• References

Practical information

This role is based in Taastrup, Denmark, and requires strong on-site presence in the data center environment. We are only open to applicants already based in Denmark

Due to security clearance requirements, you must be able to document that you have lived and worked in an EU or NATO country for the past 7 years and we are not able to offer work visa support or sponsorship for this role

At GlobalConnect, you will play a key role in building and safeguarding critical digital infrastructure that society depends on every day. You will have real technical influence, work on complex data center projects, and help shape how we design and deliver reliable infrastructure across multiple countries.

No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

Join us and be part of the transformation in the most exciting company within critical digital infrastructure in Northern Europe! Apply today!

Design the systems that guide satellites in orbit for new ambitious missions

We are seeking an experienced AOCS/GNC Engineer to design, develop, and validate attitude determination, orbit control, and autonomous navigation solutions for small satellite missions. In this role, you will develop guidance and control strategies across diverse and demanding mission profiles — from VLEO drag-dominated regimes to deep-space trajectories and asteroid proximity operations.

You will join our Advanced Missions global team, developing next-generation AOCS/GNC concepts while collaborating closely with GomSpace's established AOCS team in Aalborg — who built and flew the AOCS for the Juventas CubeSat on ESA's Hera mission and are currently developing full 6-DoF GNC for the Llevant (RAMSES) asteroid rendezvous mission.

**

Your Role**

As AOCS/GNC Engineer, you will own the attitude and orbit control design for advanced mission proposals — from requirements definition and algorithm design through high-fidelity simulation and hardware-in-the-loop validation.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Design and implement AOCS/GNC algorithms for attitude determination, control, and autonomous navigation across diverse mission profiles.

• Develop guidance and orbit-control strategies tailored to SSA, VLEO drag-dominated regimes, and deep-space trajectories.

• Model and simulate spacecraft dynamics, environmental disturbances, and sensor/actuator performance for mission-specific scenarios.

• Validate algorithms through high-fidelity simulations, Monte-Carlo analyses, and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

• Collaborate with systems, propulsion, and mission design teams to define control requirements and ensure end-to-end stability and performance.

**

What Success Looks Like**

In the initial phase, success means:

• Understanding GomSpace's AOCS product portfolio (GSW-600 reaction wheels, Auriga/Twinkle star trackers, STIM300 IMU, AOCS Flightcore software).

• Delivering your first AOCS sizing and mode analysis for a mission proposal and setting up a reusable MATLAB/Simulink simulation environment.

• Establishing working relationships with the Aalborg AOCS team and communicating AOCS trade-offs clearly to non-AOCS stakeholders.

Over time, you will be recognised for owning end-to-end AOCS/GNC design for advanced mission proposals, developing and maintaining GNC strategies across multiple mission regimes, and achieving successful Monte-Carlo validation campaigns that demonstrate algorithm robustness.

**

What You Bring**

You are an AOCS/GNC specialist with deep analytical rigour and a passion for solving complex spacecraft dynamics and control challenges across unconventional mission profiles.

You likely bring:

• An MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Astrodynamics, Control Systems, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. A PhD focused on GNC, spacecraft dynamics, or autonomous navigation is a strong plus.

• 3–5+ years of experience in AOCS/GNC algorithm design, simulation, and validation for spacecraft missions.

• Experience with attitude determination (gyro-stellar estimators, EKF/UKF), 3-axis control (sliding mode, PD/PID, LQR), and momentum management.

• Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink for spacecraft dynamics modelling and Monte-Carlo analysis.

• Experience with C/C++ implementation of flight algorithms and familiarity with AOCS sensors and actuators (star trackers, IMUs, reaction wheels, magnetorquers, RCS thrusters).

• Exposure to ESA/ECSS project lifecycle and AOCS design reviews (PDR, CDR) is highly valued.

**

Who You Are**

You combine deep mathematical rigour with creative engineering intuition. You are energised by the challenge of designing control solutions for missions that push the boundaries of what nanosatellites can do.

You are known for:

• Analytical depth — AOCS/GNC demands mathematical precision, and you deliver it.

• Creative problem solving — developing novel control strategies for unconventional mission profiles.

• Collaborative communication — translating complex dynamics and control concepts into clear requirements for systems and propulsion teams.

• Self-driven initiative — comfortable with ambiguity in early-phase mission design.

• Execution discipline – ensuring commitments are met in demanding environments.

• Customer focus – ensuring focus on customer’s success.

• True leadership — taking ownership of your domain and driving technical excellence.

**

Why Join Us**

You will play a key role in shaping future space missions at their most decisive stage. This position offers the opportunity to work closely with leading institutional customers, influence mission architectures from the start, and contribute to programs with long-term strategic impact.

**

Join our mission**

You are welcome to send your application in English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. If you have any questions regarding the position do not hesitate to contact: Gaetano Livornese, Department Manager. E-mail: gali@gomspace.com

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6 in Aalborg, Denmark. Salary and start date will be individually negotiated.

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. In close collaboration with clients, COWI co-creates innovative and sustainable solutions that enhance quality of life for current and future generations. With a primary presence in Scandinavia, the United Kingdom, North America, and India, COWI employs approximately 7,500 professionals who bring expertise across a wide range of disciplines.

If you are curious to learn more, we invite you to explore some of COWI’s featured projects at www.cowi.com or view their global portfolio at: Projects around the world (cowi.com)

On behalf of COWI, Best Talent is now seeking an Associate Project Director.

The organisation & the Team

COWI’s Building & Industry Executing Unit in Denmark, consists of approximately 1050 professionals and specialists across building related disciplines.

Within this framework, you will be part of a dedicated Multidisciplinary Project Management team in Lyngby, consisting of approximately 38 committed colleagues. This structure ensures a strong, supportive, and highly professional environment focused on excellence in project delivery.

As part of this strong professional community, you will work alongside dedicated, talented, and ambitious colleagues who are strongly committed to excellence in project leadership and management. Moreover, you will have the opportunity to realize your full potential within an inclusive and supportive professional environment.

Associate Project Director

Exiting Multidisciplinary Building Projects – From Design to Execution

• Strong focus on clients and project delivery

• Thrive in a collaborative and supportive culture

• Shape your own professional development

• Contribute to a more sustainable and livable world

The Challenge

As Associated Project Director for construction projects in Denmark, you will be responsible for the comprehensive management of building projects—from initial planning through to execution. Your role will encompass quality assurance, budget control, contractual and financial oversight, as well as the coordination of timelines and resources.

You will also act as the key liaison with clients and collaborate closely with stakeholders such as public authorities, contractors, and design partners.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Leading new construction and renovation projects from concept to completion

• Participating in large-scale projects as part of a broader project management team

• Managing complex stakeholder environments, clients, authorities, contractors, and design partners

• Maintain close collaboration with clients to ensure their needs and expectations are consistently met

• Overseeing project scope, schedule, risks, and cost management

• Ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and sustainability across all project stages

• Driving cross-disciplinary collaboration across COWI’s teams and geographies

• Contributing to the professional development of project team members

Why join COWI?

At COWI, your work contributes to shaping a sustainable and liveable world. By combining deep knowledge, curiosity, and courage, COWI develops solutions that address today’s challenges and enable a better tomorrow. COWI has committed to phasing out fossil-based projects and aspires for 100% of its revenue to stem from sustainability-focused initiatives.

COWI values diversity, continuous development, and a sense of belonging. They foster a supportive and enjoyable workplace, knowing that a healthy work-life balance enhances performance both professionally and personally. You will report to the Vice President of the group and be offered a competitive compensation package, aligned with your experience and qualifications.

Your profile & Talent:

You are an experienced Multidisciplinary Project Manager who thrives in collaboration with colleagues, partners, and clients. You foster strong relationships through integrity, accountability, and a proactive mindset. Your background has equipped you to confidently lead medium- to large-scale design projects.

Qualifications and key competencies:

• A relevant academic background in civil engineering, architecture, or a related discipline

• Professional experience in Denmark, with in-depth knowledge of all phases of the Danish building project lifecycle

• Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to manage complex project environments

• A proactive and structured approach to work, with keen attention to detail

• A self-motivated and inspiring personality that promotes teamwork and positive dynamics

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both spoken and written

Diversity and inclusion:

Diversity is a core value at COWI, and inclusion is a strategic priority. The company is committed to fostering a respectful, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all employees feel a sense of belonging and have equal opportunities for growth. Leaders at COWI are expected to model inclusive behaviour and embrace diverse perspectives as a strength in team formation and decision-making processes. These commitments are not only embedded in COWI’s values—they are part of what the company believes is the right thing to do.

Application

Best Talent is managing the recruitment process and will treat all applications with strict confidentiality.

Please send your application in English, marked “1920/Associated Project Director, COWI”, to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible due to the urgency of this position. For more information about Best Talent, please visit www.besttalent.dk.

Are you passionate about geotechnics and infrastructure? Do you want to help shape the transport networks of the future and contribute to complex and innovative projects across all types of infrastructure? Would you like to be part of a large, highly skilled geotechnical team and have the opportunity to make a real impact?

If so, we would like to hear from you.

COWI is a global consulting group that delivers innovative and sustainable solutions to complex challenges within transport, energy, environment, water, industry, buildings, and urban planning. Together with our 7,300 dedicated employees, we push the boundaries of engineering design worldwide.

Our geotechnical team in Denmark consists of more than 120 highly skilled professionals and offers a full range of world-class competencies within geotechnical engineering and tunnel design. Combined with strong local presence and experience, this enables us to take on some of the most challenging projects.

We work across a broad range of disciplines, contributing to projects including highways, metros, railways, bridges, tunnels, buildings, stormwater systems, energy infrastructure, and ground investigations. We cover all phases of the project lifecycle—from concept and design to construction, supervision, operation, and maintenance.

Your profile. Together we shape the future

As a Leading Geotechnical Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality solutions as part of a highly professional team providing consultancy, design, and project management services.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Taking technical ownership of geotechnical scope, guiding analyses, and ensuring sound engineering judgement across all project phases

• Leading and mentoring junior engineers through daily collaboration and technical reviews

• Leading the geotechnical discipline in multidisciplinary projects, including coordination with other disciplines

• Performing and reviewing design calculations (e.g. shallow and deep foundations, retaining structures, support systems for excavations, shafts etc.)

• Translating design into clear input for drawings and specifications, and coordinating effectively with drafters and designers

• Acting as a technical point of contact for clients and partners, clearly communicating assumptions, risks, and decisions

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

You take ownership of your work and ensure tasks are delivered—often by structuring, delegating, and guiding others, while remaining actively involved yourself. You have strong analytical skills and a solid understanding of geotechnical and geo-structural design, including soil–structure interaction.

You are self-motivated, collaborative, and communicate clearly in both writing and speaking.

In addition, you have:

• At least a Diploma, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in geotechnical engineering or equivalent

• A strong foundation in geotechnical engineering with minimum 10 years of experience

• Proven ability to structure work, break down tasks, and lead junior engineers

• Experience in planning, specifying, and interpreting ground investigations and integrating results into design

• Experience with Danish projects and clients, and the ability to manage client and contractor dialogue independently

• Experience working with authorities such as the Danish Road Directorate (Vejdirektoratet) and Railnet Denmark (Banedanmark)

• Strong experience with relevant modelling tools (e.g. PLAXIS, GeoStudio/Slope/W) and a clear understanding of their application and limitations

• Familiarity with design coordination and drawing production (e.g. AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit)

• Professional working proficiency in Danish, speaking and writing

Got more questions?

For further information, please contact Head of Discipline for Geotechnical Design and Modelling, Malte Larsen, MPLN@cowi.com.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

Equal opportunity employer

COWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.occupation: Client Advisor/Specialist in Data Center & Industry
jobs.description:
**Do you want to be part of the development within the data center and industry market? Can you be the client advisor handling the discipline lead for an electrical project or a design lead that collaborates with the bigger project team? Then become one of COWI's specialists within data center and industry!

****Turn challenges into sustainable solutions

**We are looking for a client advisor or specialist to join our team in the Electrical Industrial Engineering discipline in Lyngby. You will be involved in all aspects of client advisory and within the electrical engineering, we are a team of over 60 electrical professionals within the Building and Industry division. Our core services include detailed electrical design and project execution, with a focus on industrial power systems, Data Center design, Data Centre infrastructure and buildings, emergency power supply in low-voltage installations, technical due diligence, commissioning, construction management, supervision, energy screening, and other technical services related to electrical systems.

We take a holistic approach to our projects, aiming to create maximum value for our clients, who include leading Danish and international companies in the industrial and data center sectors. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to our professional development and future growth, while collaborating across Denmark and with our Engineering Design Centres in Lithuania and India, where daily teamwork is centered around delivering the highest quality solutions.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• To define design, planning, specification, follow-up, tender and procurement, supervision, and quality assurance for projects where you are the client advisor and discipline lead.

• To manage and execute tasks related to low- and medium-voltage electrical systems, emergency power systems, and data, telecommunication, and security systems.

• To co-create projects together with colleagues and customers.

• To ensure coordination across disciplines, including BIM, architects, contractors, and other partners, throughout all construction phases, while ensuring constructability.

• To contribute to the development of our professional electrical engineering environment in collaboration with our professional forum.

• To work on projects within Datacenters, Pharma, Hospitals, Transport Hubs, Industrial Buildings, and Power-to-X.

**

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you have:

• A degree in electrical engineering or similar, combined with 5–10 years of experience and extensive experience in industrial electrical systems.

• Experience with BIM and Novapoints Civil 3D design.

• You are structured and thrive in an environment with shifting priorities, where a flexible responsiveness to customer needs is necessary to obtain success.

• The ability to inspire others and be inspired by the ideas of colleagues and partners.

• Experience with client advisory services.

• High-level proficiency in spoken and written Danish and English.

**A place to work and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Got more questions?

**If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to the Head of Discipline for Electrical Industrial Engineering, Nicolai Kamuk Rosenfalck, at nkrk@cowi.com.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Christian Ljørring on +45 30 79 29 08 or Manager Rasmus Sølbeck Hansen +45 31 91 89 30

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

Do you want to use your skills in pioneering technology in a highly dynamic, ambitious environment with broad variety of exciting projects? In Welltec, cutting-edge technology and global development are high on the agenda, and we are looking for colleagues within mechanical engineering to take this journey to the next level.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

At Welltec, you will join our mechanical department situated in our completions Design & Engineering (D&E) function which currently consists of over 20 colleagues worldwide with various educational backgrounds and nationalities. In D&E we closely together - in order to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise. In D&E, the work environment is informal, creative and fun but at times it can be complex, challenging, and fast-paced.

The team that you will join is responsible for the development and maintenance of Welltec’s proprietary metal expandable packer technology and other innovative technologies which we constantly introduce to the market through our global footprint.

The position

As a mechanical engineer within Design and Engineering (D&E) you will have the possibility to be innovative and create technology solutions from the idea phase to the commercial implementation. The main task is to develop new technologies where your focus will be development of mechanical systems. You will, together with the team, be part of conceptualization of products and detailed design development both for prototypes and commercial design. You will work in an environment where you will be able to develop your skills and where innovation is a key focus and you will be part of an agile business where your input will be heard. Travelling for exhibition and conferences related to the energy market can be expected to a smaller extent.

As our new Mechanical Engineer, you will:

• Be part of concept phase as team and have ownership of design and manufacturing package

• Conduct prototype assembly and function testing/troubleshooting

Ensure collaboration with relevant teams and stakeholders within the organisation

• Cooperate with sub-contractors

• Take ownership of schedules and delivery times

• Challenge the business with new ideas and concepts

• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Design and Engineering (D&E) department

Your tasks will include:

• Work on technical projects through all development phases

• Working in teams on development projects with both own and shared tasks

• Conceptualization and feasibility studies

• Design review guided by DFM, FMEA principles and robust design thinking

• 3D mechanical design

• Trouble shooting on both existing solutions as well as new solutions under development

• Provide your guidance and input in your specific expert areas across the whole organization

The candidate

You are proactive in your daily tasks and have an analytical and critical approach to problem solving. You have a quick, creative mind with a natural understanding of complex concepts and systems. The ideal candidate is someone who gets excited by technology and open-ended challenges as described above. In order to perform well in this role, you should also have the following qualifications or similar competencies:

The preferred candidate has the following profile:

• Mechanical Engineer B.Sc, M.Sc. or similar background

• Experience from oilfield, energy sector, hydraulics, precision mechanics, electro mechanical systems, mechatronics or similar is a plus

• Takes ownership of tasks and projects – enjoys broad responsibility

• Agile Project Management skills

• Is an experienced CAD user in Catia Software or similar system

• Is experienced in the use of FEA simulations in ANSYS or similar system

• Most importantly – commitment to learn the skills not yet acquired but required for the job

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

The process

If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online via the link below.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.

Are you an experienced power trader who enjoys making decisions in fast-moving markets? Would you like to take responsibility for your own trades while working alongside colleagues who share your interest in intraday power trading?

Join our IDE Proprietary Trading team at Norlys Energy Trading in Aalborg. Here, you will use your trading experience to identify opportunities, act on market developments, and contribute to the team's trading activities.

Your team and role

You will join a team of experienced traders working in the intraday power market. The role combines market analysis, trade execution, and risk management with the development of trading strategies.

The desk operates around the clock, and you will be part of our 24/7 shift rotation. You will work independently on trading decisions while exchanging market insights and ideas with colleagues across shifts.

Your key responsibilities

• Analyse market data and price movements to identify trading opportunities.

• Develop and execute intraday trading strategies.

• Monitor positions, manage risk, and respond to changing market conditions.

• Collaborate with traders, analysts and quantitative teams to challenge market views, share insights, and improve trading strategies and decision-making.

• Contribute to improving trading tools, models and processes in collaboration with relevant teams to strengthen analytical capabilities and trading efficiency.

• Coordinate with colleagues across shifts to ensure continuity in trading activities.

• Maintain relationships with relevant market participants and stakeholders.

You'll be joining a desk where different perspectives and trading ideas are part of the conversation. There's room to share your experience, challenge ideas and learn from the people around you.

Jacob Goth

Manager, Proprietary Trading

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced trader who combines sound market judgement with the ability to act independently and contribute to a team.

You bring:

• Experience in energy trading, preferably within intraday power.

• Strong analytical skills and a solid understanding of trading strategies and risk management.

• The ability to make well-founded decisions under pressure.

• Good communication skills and an interest in sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• A relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field.

You should be comfortable working in a 24/7 shift rotation and ready to apply your trading experience from an early stage.

What we offer

You will become part of a specialist trading environment where colleagues share market knowledge, discuss trading ideas, and learn from each other's experience. With responsibility for your own trading activities and opportunities to contribute to strategy development, you will have room to put your expertise to work.

Beyond the trading desk, you will be part of Norlys Energy Trading's wider professional and social community, including an active staff association that brings colleagues together across teams.

The position is permanent, full-time and based at our office in Aalborg, with an expected start date of 1 February 2027.

Interested?

If the role sounds like a good match for your experience, we'd like to hear from you.

Want to know more?

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about this opportunity

Jacob Goth

Manager, Proprietary Trading

jgo@norlysenergytrading.com

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026 – Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU), Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results.

Eligibility:

Educational requirements

a. Be enrolled in a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) and have completed one full academic year;

b. Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as master’s programme or higher);

c. Have recently graduated with a university degree as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation; or

d. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional trainee programme and undertake the internship as part of this programme.

Other eligibility requirements

e. Demonstrate interest in the field of development;

f.  Demonstrate written and spoken proficiency in at least one of the working languages of the United Nations (English or French) and fluency in the official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish) of the UNFPA office; and

g. Demonstrate ability to adapt to new environments and to establish and maintain good working relations with individuals of different cultural backgrounds.

An individual whose father, mother, son, daughter, brother or sister is a UNFPA staff member is not eligible for an internship with UNFPA.

Required Competencies:

Values:

• Exemplifying integrity,

• Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,

• Embracing cultural diversity,

• Embracing change

Core Competencies:

• Achieving results,

• Being accountable,

• Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,

• Thinking analytically and strategically,

• Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Financial Support:

Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses. The stipend is based on the intern’s agreed place of work, which may be different from the duty station of the hiring office in cases of remote arrangements. The stipend is normally paid in local currency at the end of each month.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

Disclaimer:

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

Strategy and business development

Innovation & New Ventures Lead

Imagine a future where you build entirely new businesses that accelerate the green transition and unlock new sources of value.

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll originate and build new ventures from the ground up, turning bold ideas into scalable businesses. You’ll shape opportunities, validate them with the market, and drive early commercialisation, working across functions and leveraging the strength of a global organisation.

Welcome to Ventures & Open Innovation

You’ll be part of a team focused on identifying and scaling transformational opportunities, where you together with your colleagues will explore new markets, business models, and technologies. You’ll collaborate closely across engineering, commercial, and business development functions to bring new ideas to life. As a team, we support each other, challenge ideas constructively, and work with curiosity and ownership to turn ambition into impact.

You’ll play an important role in:

• 
originating new business opportunities by identifying white spaces and shaping opportunity areas

• 
leading end-to-end venture building from ideation through validation to early commercialisation

• 
designing and testing business models through structured experimentation and rapid learning

• 
collaborating with internal stakeholders to unlock capabilities and move opportunities forward

• 
translating technical assets and capabilities into new commercial propositions

• 
contributing to innovation strategy and portfolio prioritisation.

To succeed in the role, you:

• 
have hands-on experience building new businesses or ventures from concept to launch

• 
bring a strong commercial mindset, focusing on customers, value creation, and revenue models

• 
are comfortable working across ambiguity and can create structure and direction independently

• 
collaborate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, or equivalent experience

• 
demonstrate curiosity and quickly build understanding in new industries or domains

• 
communicate clearly and persuasively, building alignment around new ideas.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr62,160.00- kr93,240.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Imagine a future with Ørsted

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

**About Ørsted

**

• We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.

• Our vision is to create a world that runs entirely on green energy.

• We built the world’s first offshore wind farm, Vindeby in Denmark, in 1991, and completed the world’s largest, Hornsea 2 in the UK, in 2022.

• We were founded in Denmark in 2006 and now have approximately 8,000 employees, working in 15 countries and counting.

An inclusive team

At Ørsted, we strive to be an inclusive workplace where you’re respected for who you are, valued for the unique perspectives you bring, and rewarded fairly for what you achieve. We want all employees to have the same opportunities for impact and growth, no matter their age, race, ethnicity, place of birth, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.

jobs.occupation: System Manager, AC Skid – BESS (Medium Voltage Containerized Systems)
jobs.description:
System Manager, AC Skid – BESS (Medium Voltage Containerized Systems)

Shape the backbone of the energy transition

Are you passionate about building reliable, future-ready energy systems?

Do you enjoy working at the intersection of electrical engineering, system integration, and real-world impact?

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark

Responsibilities

Serve as the overall system‑responsible owner for the AC Skid, covering electrical/functional architecture, safety, quality, and lifecycle performance.

Lead supplier selection, qualification, and governance for the mechanical Skid design, ensuring alignment with system requirements, standards, and cost targets.

Own the technical selection and specification of:

• MV transformer

• RMU

• PCS (in house designed converter integration and interfaces

Ensure correct electrical and functional integration of all subsystems:

• MV transformer – RMU – PCS

• Grounding/earthing

• Cooling and auxiliary power

• Cabling, interlocks, protections, and monitoring

Review and validate supplier designs for the mechanical skid

Ensure compliance with relevant standards:

• MV equipment (IEC/ANSI)

• Transformer and switchgear safety

The Deloitte Master's Thesis Hub bridges bright students with unanswered questions Deloitte is curious about.

The program is a great place to meet like-minded students navigating the ups and downs of thesis writing. Best of all, you'll have the invaluable opportunity to get guidance and support during the writing process and tap into the expertise of Deloitte's thought leaders, who will guide you on the path of creating an impactful master thesis!

Our Deloitte experts will be able to provide collaboration and guidance within the following five research topics:

• M&A & Strategy

• Sustainability & ESG

• Financial Performance & Reporting

• Digital Transformation & AI

• Organization & Change Management

Deloitte invests in providing relevant business insight and latest industry trends, challenging your thought process, and giving access to a large network of experts in the specific problem domain. We help develop your problem-solving skills and show you tips and tricks to present research findings concisely. Most importantly, the Master's Thesis Hub offers a room for reflection and shared learning between participants and experts.

By applying to the Master’s Thesis Hub, you will commit to attending four dedicated sessions from January – April 2026 for shared learning and pro-level guidance. To round of the Master Thesis Hub we will have a celebration dinner in June 2026, to congratulate you on your new degree. All sessions will be held in the Deloitte office in Copenhagen (Weidekampsgade 6, 2300 Copenhagen S). Note that it is a requirement to attend all sessions physically at the Copenhagen office to be a part of the program.

Are you ready? We are looking forward to receiving your application!

How to apply?

To apply, click "I'm interested" and upload your CV (along with the CVs of your group members if applicable). You will also be asked to answer a few practical questions.

Final deadline for signing up is the 4th of December. You will receive a response regarding your application shortly thereafter.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.
